title: Vue d'ensemble
description: État de la plateforme en un coup d'œil, et les dernières analyses satellites tracées de bout en bout

panels.title: Collecte
panels.description: Dernier fichier Parquet écrit. Rouge au seuil de l'alerte (SEUIL_COLLECTE_MIN), orange à sa moitié.

targets.rawSql: SELECT now() AS time, CASE WHEN m IS NULL THEN 'aucun fichier relevé' ELSE 'Fichier il y a ' || greatest(round(m), 0)::int || ' min' END AS metric, CASE WHEN m IS NULL OR m > s THEN 2 WHEN m > s / 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS value FROM (SELECT (SELECT extract(epoch FROM now() - dernier_le) / 60 AS minutes FROM signes_de_vie WHERE service = 'collecte') AS m, coalesce((SELECT valeur FROM parametres_supervision WHERE cle = 'seuil_collecte_min'), 5) AS s) x

panels.title: Ingestion
panels.description: Retard de l'ingestion. Rouge au seuil de l'alerte (SEUIL_INGESTION_MIN), orange à sa moitié.

targets.rawSql: SELECT now() AS time, CASE WHEN m IS NULL THEN 'aucun passage relevé' ELSE 'Retard ' || greatest(round(m), 0)::int || ' min' END AS metric, CASE WHEN m IS NULL OR m > s THEN 2 WHEN m > s / 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS value FROM (SELECT (SELECT greatest(extract(epoch FROM now() - dernier_le), coalesce((detail->>'retard_s')::float8, 0)) / 60 AS minutes FROM signes_de_vie WHERE service = 'ingestion') AS m, coalesce((SELECT valeur FROM parametres_supervision WHERE cle = 'seuil_ingestion_min'), 10) AS s) x

panels.title: Disque
panels.description: Espace libre. Rouge sous le seuil de l'alerte (SEUIL_DISQUE_LIBRE_PCT), orange jusqu'à SEUIL_DISQUE_ORANGE_PTS points au dessus ; mêmes couleurs que l'indicateur Disque de la barre d'état.

targets.rawSql: SELECT now() AS time, CASE WHEN pct IS NULL THEN 'aucune mesure' ELSE round(pct)::int || ' % libres, ' || replace(round(go::numeric, 1)::text, '.', ',') || ' Go' END AS metric, CASE WHEN pct IS NULL THEN -1 WHEN pct < s THEN 2 WHEN pct < s + marge THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS value FROM (SELECT (SELECT libre_pct FROM mesures_disque ORDER BY mesure_le DESC LIMIT 1) AS pct, (SELECT libre_octets / 1e9 FROM mesures_disque ORDER BY mesure_le DESC LIMIT 1) AS go, coalesce((SELECT valeur FROM parametres_supervision WHERE cle = 'seuil_disque_pct'), 15) AS s, coalesce((SELECT valeur FROM parametres_supervision WHERE cle = 'seuil_disque_orange_pts'), 10) AS marge) x

panels.title: Tâches
panels.description: Échecs des tâches sur 24 h (refus attendus exclus). Rouge si une tâche échoue ECHECS_SUCCESSIFS fois de suite (alerte), orange dès un échec.

targets.rawSql: SELECT now() AS time, CASE n WHEN 0 THEN 'aucun échec sur 24 h' WHEN 1 THEN '1 échec sur 24 h' ELSE n || ' échecs sur 24 h' END AS metric, CASE WHEN suite > 0 THEN 2 WHEN n > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS value FROM (SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM task_runs WHERE status = 'echec' AND NOT (details ? 'refus') AND started_at > now() - interval '24 hours') AS n, (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT task, array_agg(status ORDER BY started_at DESC) AS st FROM task_runs WHERE started_at > now() - interval '7 days' AND status <> 'en_cours' AND NOT (details ? 'refus') GROUP BY task) t WHERE array_length(st, 1) >= coalesce((SELECT valeur FROM parametres_supervision WHERE cle = 'seuil_echecs_successifs'), 2)::int AND st[1:coalesce((SELECT valeur FROM parametres_supervision WHERE cle = 'seuil_echecs_successifs'), 2)::int] <@ ARRAY['echec']) AS suite) x

panels.title: Satellites
panels.description: Dernière nuit VIIRS traitée. Rouge si la nuit précédente manque après HEURE_NUIT_VIIRS (alerte), orange si un travailleur a échoué en 24 h.

targets.rawSql: SELECT now() AS time, CASE WHEN absente THEN 'Nuit du ' || to_char(veille, 'DD/MM') || ' absente' WHEN nuit IS NULL THEN 'aucune nuit VIIRS traitée' ELSE 'Nuit du ' || to_char(nuit, 'DD/MM') || ' traitée' END AS metric, CASE WHEN absente THEN 2 WHEN nuit IS NULL THEN -1 WHEN echec THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS value FROM (SELECT (SELECT max(nuit) FROM viirs_granules WHERE traite_le IS NOT NULL) AS nuit, (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date - 1 AS veille, extract(hour FROM now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') >= coalesce((SELECT valeur FROM parametres_supervision WHERE cle = 'seuil_heure_nuit_viirs'), 8) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM viirs_granules WHERE nuit = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date - 1 AND traite_le IS NOT NULL) AS absente, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM travailleurs WHERE etat = 'echec' AND cree_le > now() - interval '24 hours') AS echec) x

panels.title: Traces
panels.description: Spans reçus par le collecteur en 1 h. Rouge s'il est muet depuis SEUIL_COLLECTEUR_MUET_MIN, injoignable ou s'il refuse des spans (alertes), orange si sa file d'attente dépasse 100 lots.

targets.rawSql: SELECT now() AS time, CASE WHEN NOT mesure THEN 'aucune mesure du collecteur' ELSE replace(to_char(coalesce(recus, 0), 'FM999,999,990'), ',', ' ') || ' spans en 1 h' END AS metric, CASE WHEN NOT mesure THEN -1 WHEN NOT joignable OR coalesce(muet, 1e9) > coalesce((SELECT valeur FROM parametres_supervision WHERE cle = 'seuil_collecteur_muet_min'), 15) OR refus > 0 THEN 2 WHEN coalesce(file, 0) > 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS value FROM (SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mesures_otel WHERE mesure_le > now() - interval '30 minutes') AS mesure, coalesce((SELECT joignable FROM mesures_otel ORDER BY mesure_le DESC LIMIT 1), false) AS joignable, (SELECT file_attente FROM mesures_otel ORDER BY mesure_le DESC LIMIT 1) AS file, (SELECT sum(greatest(recus - prec, 0)) FROM (SELECT mesure_le, recus, lag(recus) OVER (ORDER BY mesure_le) AS prec FROM mesures_otel WHERE mesure_le > now() - interval '61 minutes') d WHERE mesure_le > now() - interval '1 hour') AS recus, (SELECT extract(epoch FROM now() - max(mesure_le) FILTER (WHERE recus > prec)) / 60 AS minutes FROM (SELECT mesure_le, recus, lag(recus) OVER (ORDER BY mesure_le) AS prec FROM mesures_otel WHERE mesure_le > now() - interval '1 day') x WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mesures_otel WHERE mesure_le > now() - interval '30 minutes')) AS muet, (SELECT coalesce(sum(greatest(refuses - prec, 0)), 0) AS refus FROM (SELECT mesure_le, refuses, lag(refuses) OVER (ORDER BY mesure_le) AS prec FROM mesures_otel WHERE mesure_le > now() - interval '16 minutes') x WHERE mesure_le > now() - interval '15 minutes') AS refus) x

panels.title: Dernières traces de bout en bout
panels.description: Analyses satellites (travailleurs VIIRS et Sentinel 1) : une trace chacune, du lancement à la destruction. Le lien de la colonne Trace ouvre la vue Gantt dans Tempo (72 h gardées).

targets.rawSql: SELECT cree_le AS "Lancée le", CASE tache WHEN 'viirs' THEN 'VIIRS' WHEN 'sentinel' THEN 'Sentinel 1' ELSE tache END AS "Analyse", round(extract(epoch FROM coalesce(detruit_le, now()) - cree_le) / 60)::int || ' min' AS "Durée totale", etat AS "Statut", left(coalesce(erreur, '·'), 140) AS "Motif", trace_id AS "Trace" FROM travailleurs WHERE trace_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY cree_le DESC LIMIT 20

defaults.noValue: aucune analyse satellite tracée depuis le déploiement
